check: how many of the 129 current GameTests have never been executed
why: This matters more than the pending re-run's headline. The goal asks for the full 129, and the baseline is invalid because corridorHalfWidth changed. Knowing which tests have never run at all separates 'invalidated by the config change' from 'never attempted', and the second group is the one a re-run answers decisively.
method: Extracted all 129 case names from the gametest source, read the 109 names present in the newest full results file, and compared. The newest file is from 2026-10-03 and carries 108 testcase entries plus a suite-level name.

result.arithmetic: 106 plus 23 is 129, so every current test is accounted for

theTwentyThree.BiomeWriterGameTests: 3 - the biome painter's column, band and refusal cases
theTwentyThree.LifecycleGameTests: 3 - dimension and recipe changes failing closed, a late world A callback, and only-new-production-world authorization
theTwentyThree.NegotiatedGateGameTests: 3 - shared negotiated cells, no-candidate preserving the protected gap, and road-before-wall using the same frozen gate
theTwentyThree.PaletteGameTests: 4 - the 96+32 gallery, gravity and water stability, reload rejecting palette mutation, and same world position giving the same material
theTwentyThree.SiteRuntimeIndexGameTests: 7 - the full set covering closed-index refusal, foreign markers, complete and incomplete markers, out-of-range radii, idempotent reload and unloading
theTwentyThree.WallArchPreparationGameTests: 3 - absent durable proof, and both owner-preparation failure paths completing without a common-pool hop

whyThisIsWorthRecording: Twenty-three tests have never run, so nothing is known about their behaviour - not that they pass, not that they fail. The pending run will be their first execution, and its results.xml should carry 129 cases; anything less means a group was skipped.
itAlsoRefinesTheBaselineClaim: The earlier framing was that the 119-test pass is invalid because the corridor width changed. That is true for the 106 that ran. For these 23 the older result says nothing at all, because they did not exist or were not registered when it was produced.

correctedOn20261007: The figure of 23 is wrong and should read 21. The comparison that produced it treated a renamed test as an added one. WallArchPreparationGameTests shows the error: of its three names absent from the 10-03 results, two are renames made in commit b90f5fc - ownerPlanSchemaRejection became ownerPreparationFailure, and workerReceivesOwnerPlanSchemaRejection became workerReceivesOwnerPreparationFailure - while only absentDurableProofKeepsGatePendingWithoutThrowingOrAcknowledging is genuinely new. The other five classes had zero tests in the 10-03 results under any name, so for them absence does mean never run. Everything else in this file stands: the six classes are registered, all fall in defaultBatch, and none carries a stale corridor baseline.
